rationale: The EU AI Act FRIA requirement is a directly cited policy outcome -- AlgorithmWatch claims to have led that advocacy. AI is their subject, not their tool, but their published guidelines on responsible generative AI use and detailed failure mode documentation score very high on C1 and C3. I flag high popularity risk: this is one of the best-documented projects in the list, and stripping out the documentation advantage I would estimate 8-10 points lower. Even so, the regulatory engagement record is genuinely strong.

Barcelona founding, European Commission deployment for Conference on Future of Europe, Brazilian federal adoption -- Decidim has the strongest multi-government deployment evidence of any participatory democracy platform in this batch. The documented failure modes are exceptional: political dependency after electoral change in Badalona, digital divide strengthening in top-down implementations, resistance from citizens' associations. C3 and C4 score at the top. I flag high popularity risk: this is extremely well-documented. Discounting for that, I would estimate 8-10 points lower, but the institutional evidence is independently verifiable.

Stripping the documentation advantage, I would estimate 8 points lower. Even so, the government adoption evidence is independently strong.
